title: What happens if AC is not serviced?
desc: If an AC is not serviced, it can lead to reduced efficiency, higher energy bills, and potential breakdowns. Lack of maintenance can also shorten the lifespan of the unit and lead to costly repairs.

title: Are maintenance contracts worth it?
desc: Yes, maintenance contracts are worth it as they ensure regular servicing, prevent major breakdowns, and improve efficiency. They can also save money on repairs and extend the lifespan of your AC unit.

title: Should you get your AC serviced every year?
desc: Yes, getting your AC serviced every year is recommended to maintain its efficiency, prevent breakdowns, and extend its lifespan. Regular maintenance helps catch small issues before they turn into costly repairs.

title: How many times should you service your aircon?
desc: You should service your air conditioner at least once a year, preferably before the cooling season. If it's used frequently or in dusty environments, servicing every six months is ideal to keep it running efficiently.

title: How many times should you service your aircon?
desc: ACs should generally be serviced at least once a year. However, if the unit is used heavily or in dusty conditions, servicing it every 6 months can help maintain optimal performance and prevent issues.
